trailhead.label: The lower car park at the Arnoga hairpin, the published start

cautions: A natural balcony over the Viola canyon on the steeper stretch above the Caricc farm: keep your dog close and on a short lead.
Cattle graze the Val Viola in summer: keep your distance.
Above 2,000 m the open stretch to the hut has no shade and storms build fast on summer afternoons.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.A natural balcony over the Viola canyon: Un balcone naturale sul canyon del Viola nel tratto più ripido sopra il maso Caricc: tieni il cane vicino e con il guinzaglio corto.
textIt.Cattle graze the Val Viola in summer: ke: D'estate il bestiame pascola in Val Viola: mantieni le distanze.
textIt.Above 2,000 m the open stretch to the hu: Oltre i 2.000 m il tratto aperto fino al rifugio è senza ombra e nei pomeriggi estivi i temporali si formano in fretta.
